title: StepZero station graph
description: One file per Tier-2 station (data/build/graphs/<station_id>.json), produced by `python -m importer.run`. Topology and edge attributes come from the ほこナビ walking network; GTFS-Pathways data is attached by matching (docs/decisions.md D-014). Optional fields that are absent mean 'unknown', never 'zero'.

nodeId.description: <station_id>:<source>:<local_id>. Source is 'hokonavi' for every node today.

level.description: ほこナビ floor. 0 is outdoor ground; halves are mezzanines; negative is below ground.

name.description: Entrance labels (e.g. D1). Only languages present in the source are given.

gtfsStopId.description: Matched GTFS-Pathways stop_id, when there is one.

platformId.description: For boarding areas (kind 'platform'): the GTFS platform stop_id, e.g. 421P3. A boarding area left out of its platform's nodeIds (warning boarding_area_outside_gates) keeps it.

gtfsLevel.description: Present only when the Pathways level_id differs from `level` (a level conflict); `level` is kept.

seconds.description: Base traversal time from importer/graph/timing.py (assumed speeds, not measured).

slopePct.description: UPPER bound of the ほこナビ slope bucket (0, 5, 8, 18). 18 means 'above 8%' and covers both 8-18% and over 18%. Direction (up or down) is not kept.

widthM.description: LOWER bound of the ほこナビ width bucket (0 means under 1.0 m; then 1.0, 2.0, 3.0).

stepHeightCm.description: UPPER bound of the ほこナビ step bucket (0, 2, 5, 10). 10 means 'above 5 cm' and covers 5-10 cm and over 10 cm.

pathwayId.description: GTFS pathway_id of the matched pathway. Absent for ほこナビ links with no pathway; outage reports then key on the edge id.

bidirectional.description: When false the edge runs from -> to only.

travel.description: Which way trains run along the platform (step 2.6, boarding position). Absent when the timetable and the station positions cannot tell. Derived, not published by the operator: see docs/data-notes.md.

frontNodeId.description: Boarding area at the end of the platform where the front of the train stops.

backNodeId.description: Boarding area at the other end.

lengthM.description: Distance between the outermost boarding areas along the platform axis; not necessarily the platform length.

areas.description: Number of boarding areas the axis is taken from.

confidence.description: 'weak' when the neighbouring stations lie well off the platform axis (curved tunnel); both still agree on the direction.

approximate.description: Fewer than 6 boarding areas: the ends of the platform are uncertain.

nextStop.description: Station most trips go to next. Absent when every trip ends here.

prevStop.description: Station most trips come from. Absent when every trip starts here.

headsigns.description: Headsigns shown by at least 10% of the platform's trips, most common first.

terminating.description: Whether trips end at this platform.

reachability.description: Per platform: reachable from an entrance (in) and an entrance reachable from it (out) without stairs, escalators, slopes above 8% or steps above 5 cm. 'strict' also blocks edges whose slope or step height is unknown.
